<subject>Safety Induction Coordinator 2024</subject>
<body>
My name is Andrea Reeves and I am the Safety Induction Coordinator for Annette Reid this year. I know that you were the induction coordinators for your departments last year. I do not have confirmation as to who the induction coordinators are for your departments this year. Will you please respond to this email and let me know if you are an induction coordinator for a department this year? If you are not your department's induction coordinator, would you please (if you know) tell me who is this year's coordinator (please include the department number(s) in your return email. I have sent out three emails to the department managers today and would like to get the information to your department's manager as soon as possible. Thanks for your help!
</body>

</quoted>
